details: Go 1.26.11's html/template fixes (CVE-2026-56858 and go.dev/issue/81821, 81823): a value after `{`, `}`, `${`, `yield`, a keyword property or a `#private` name in a script is escaped for the right regexp or division context; `<script type="">` is JavaScript; `url =` in a meta refresh is filtered; branches at different template literal brace depths do not join. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.

Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
